title: Promo codes

help.title: About promo codes
help.overview: A promo code takes a percentage or a fixed amount off the rental days. Extras, fees and charges are never discounted.

sections.title: On this page
items: Leave the dates empty to accept a code at any time.
A code is counted when a booking with it is made, so it can't be used more often than allowed.
Turn a code off to stop it without deleting it.
